description: bits-ui's DropdownMenu compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified dropdown-menu and button wrappers and the dropdown-menu-demo (groups, labels, shortcuts, separators, a disabled item and the Invite users submenu). Opened by a press on the trigger, the pointer over an item (highlighted), over the submenu trigger (the submenu opens after its delay) and into the submenu, a press on its first item selecting it and closing both menus with focus back on the trigger; opened by Enter (focus on the first item), arrow keys through the items (looping, the disabled one skipped), ArrowRight into the submenu and ArrowLeft back, Escape closing it with focus on the trigger; reopened by a press on the trigger and closed by a press outside (`covered`). The portal, floating-ui positioning of the content and the submenu (flipped to the left in the narrow viewport), data-state and data-highlighted, the open and close animations
